en-US.author: CAST AI Group, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal coding agent powered by multi-model orchestration.
en-US.longDescription: Kimchi is a terminal coding agent that routes tasks to different large language models by role, such as orchestrator, builder, reviewer, and explorer, through its multi-model orchestration.
en-US.name: Kimchi
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Features
- feat(acp): resolved command title in background-wait tool rows by @vmizg in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1727
- feat(acp): run-boundary notification for agent-initiated turns by @vmizg in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1728
- feat(acp): backgrounded tool calls stay in_progress until process exit by @vmizg in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1729
Bug Fixes
- fix(clipboard): harden image pasting against non-image data by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1476
- perf: fix the resume-turn instruction regression from #1659 (mermaid lex + redaction paint gates) by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1723
- fix(todos): advance the check-in revision and arm the gate at message delivery by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1696
- fix(setup-wizard): gate first-run wizard on a genuinely interactive launch by @mikenorgate in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1726
- fix(acp): activate OAuth on the session model runtime so SSO logins can create sessions by @cast-vytautas in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1734
- fix(tui): ask git for the branch on reftable repositories by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1732
- fix(mcp): re-read shared OAuth credentials before and on refresh failures by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1710
- fix(permissions): blocklist always wins over YOLO approval-skip by @Mahamadou828 in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1683
Other Changes
- ci(perf): gate PRs on deterministic resource budgets (CPU, disk, memory, latency) by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1617
- adding status line indicating when memory was use during a session by @Mahamadou828 in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1660
- ci: bump Bun to 1.4.4 in CI setup by @mszostok in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1738
Full Changelog: https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/compare/v1.34.2...v1.34.3

zh-CN.description: 由多模型编排驱动的终端编码代理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kimchi 是一款终端编码代理，通过多模型编排按角色（编排者、构建者、审查者、探索者等）将任务路由到不同的大语言模型。
